label.purpose: Rare section grouping and table hierarchy.

numeric.purpose: Primary live metrics using tabular figures.

copy.name: presentation-boundary
copy.purpose: Centralized sentence-case labels for roles, statuses, imports, metrics, fields, and audit actions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 13px; border: 1px solid #1f5eff; border-radius: 6px; background: #1f5eff; color: #fff; font: 650 14px/1.2 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #154be0; border-color: #154be0; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8eb0ff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 13px; border: 1px solid #b9c6d8; border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; color: #12213d; font: 650 14px/1.2 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: #f8faff; border-color: #8ea0b7; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8eb0ff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #12213d; font: 650 13px/1.3 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 11px; border: 1px solid #b9c6d8; border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; color: #12213d; font: 400 16px/1.4 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: #1f5eff; outline: 3px solid #cbdcff; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Metric Surface
components.description: One scoped metric with its definition.
components.css: .ds-metric { display: grid; align-content: start; min-height: 132px; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid #d7dfeb; border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; color: #12213d; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-metric span, .ds-metric small { color: #5c6b82; font-size: 12px; } .ds-metric strong { margin-top: 16px; font-size: 27px; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.025em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-metric small { margin-top: 5px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: Current destination in the midnight rail.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid #4b7cff; border-radius: 6px; background: #1f5eff; color: #fff; font: 550 12px/1.2 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-active svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #8eb0ff; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: A compact, calm operations console that connects scoped performance to the active data trail. Midnight navigation anchors a bright, border-led working canvas. Expression comes from exact composition, typography, and live data rather than promotional decoration.

rules.name: The Rare Blue Rule
rules.body: Electric blue marks interaction or the most important series; it does not wash content regions.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Borders establish hierarchy; shadow identifies a priority surface or temporary layer.

rules.name: The Presentation Boundary Rule
rules.body: Internal identifiers are translated once in the presentation layer and never exposed as primary copy.

dos: Do preserve server-rendered scope and authorization.
Do keep active-version context near the affected decision.
Do use compact, human-readable labels and tabular figures.
donts: Don't fabricate metrics, identities, comparisons, or controls.
Don't use gradients, glass, decorative blur, or giant marketing type.
Don't show raw identifiers or enum keys as the primary label.
